authority.boundary: The BLOCK_HEADER layout handle is present in R2000+; R13/R14 LAYOUT has a forward associated-block pointer.

change: A shared staged association resolver checks unique legacy forward references and rejects source backlinks in R13/R14 DWG; all DXF and R2000+ DWG inputs retain reciprocal checks. The legacy output path remains refused until source, graph and target projection qualify. Failure does not change the staged association result.

validation.focused: libdxfrw_layout_associations CTest covers source-mode selection, valid associations, duplicate/null/missing targets, unexpected legacy backlinks, reciprocal mismatches and corrected retry.
validation.candidate: 32 conversions: both versions, null/bound SHAPE, default/R2000 target, strict/partial, ASCII/binary. Every attempt failed preserving the destination. Bound and partial attempts reached the explicit unqualified-projection refusal; strict null refused the incomplete read.
validation.peer: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 exports the R13 bound control to R2000 ASCII with BLOCK_RECORD 340 equal to 0 for both layouts, even though each LAYOUT 330 points to its block record. ezdxf 1.4.5 reports reciprocal links after load because layouts/layout.py unconditionally sets block_record.dxf.layout to the LAYOUT handle. A loaded graph therefore does not prove the on-disk 340 values.
validation.sanitizers: The focused association executable passes when built with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.
validation.regressions: Existing libdxfrw_layout_graph_read_contract and libdxfrw_layout_objects_allocation_retry CTests pass. The generated AC1012 partial-output transaction CTest also passes.
validation.inventory: Build inventory check passes with the new header, test, and previously missing generator included in the source-release manifest.

limitations: No R13/R14 layout-bearing source profile is approved for output by this slice.
The producer controls are not native AutoCAD witnesses and their null SHAPE reference is not independently established as valid.
The R2000 output representation, complete source/frame/role and dictionary semantics, independent physical output/readback, and corrected same-adapter export retry remain open.
